item.title: Why Experimental Details Matter: Recovering from a Flawed Interpretability Study
item.description: A striking interpretability result survived preregistration and still came from a flawed comparison. We trace how prompt echo, a domain-mismatched lexicon, and unequal stakes produced an overconfident story; retract the invalid chart; and show how a corrected, frozen re-run changed what the experiment could support.
